profile.headline: Systems Programmer
profile.summary: Systems programmer with a focus on graphics and performance. Experience in writing network servers, drivers, graphics APIs, and compilers. Love working on anything that requires an understanding of the underlying hardware or has strong performance or efficiency constraints.

positions.title: Principal System Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implementation of Direct3D drivers for NVIDIA GPUs. Involved in designing the D3D11 API, and led the driver implementation. D3D driver lead for hardware/software interface and ISA design for GT200, Fermi, and Kepler GPU architectures. Led the team porting D3D drivers to ARM and Tegra for Windows 8.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of a small team (2-3 engineers), built the Novell Internet Messaging System (NIMS), a distributed standards-based email server product for the NetWare operating system. Implemented large parts of the POP3 and IMAP protocol servers, and designed and implemented a webmail interface with embedded HTTP server. Involved in debugging and performance optimization for all components of the system.

publications.title: Clustered Principal Components for Precomputed Radiance Transfer
